input.story: I ordered a phone worth Rs 32,999 on an e-commerce site on 2 Sept 2026. It was delivered with a cracked screen, I returned it on 5 Sept and they picked it up, but the refund still hasn't come. Customer care keeps saying 7-10 days. I have the order invoice and pickup receipt. I live in Hyderabad.

assessment.where_you_stand: You are a consumer who purchased a defective product that arrived with a cracked screen, making you eligible for a full refund of Rs 32,999 under the Consumer Protection Act [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Having your order invoice and pickup receipt gives you strong initial proof of the purchase and return. However, your case would be even stronger with customer care chat transcripts or complaint reference numbers [KB:ecom_grievance_officer]. Since the return was completed recently on September 5, 2026, you are well within the standard 2-year time limit to pursue a consumer complaint [KB:cpa_limitation].

options.title: Contact E-commerce Grievance Officer
options.what_to_do: Write a formal email to the platform's grievance officer demanding your refund of Rs 32,999, attaching your order invoice and pickup receipt.

options.title: File a complaint on National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch]
options.what_to_do: Call 1915 or file your grievance online at consumerhelpline.gov.in to get pre-litigation mediation help.

options.title: File a Consumer Commission Complaint
options.what_to_do: File a complaint online through the e-Jagriti [KB:forum_ejagriti] portal if the company fails to refund your money.

proof_tips: Check your email and SMS for any return confirmation messages or ticket numbers from customer care.
If you chatted with support previously, take screenshots of those conversations to use as proof.
what_i_dont_know: Whether the e-commerce platform's internal warehouse team has already processed or rejected the return.
The exact name of the e-commerce platform and their specific refund policies.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: You can handle the initial grievance steps and consumer helpline complaints yourself without a lawyer, especially since no court case has been filed yet.
assessment.reply: As a consumer who returned a damaged phone worth Rs 32,999, you have a strong right to a full refund [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Because you have your order invoice and pickup receipt, you already possess key proof of the transaction and return. E-commerce platforms are required to resolve grievances within a specific timeframe once notified in writing [KB:ecom_grievance_officer]. Since your refund is delayed, your best first step is to write directly to the platform's grievance officer or file a free complaint with the National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch]. If that does not work, you can file a complaint online on the e-Jagriti portal without paying any court fee for claims under Rs 5 lakh [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh] [KB:forum_ejagriti]. Do you have any complaint reference numbers or chat transcripts from when you previously spoke with customer care?

draft.title: Consumer Complaint before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Hyderabad
draft.body:
BEFORE THE DISTRICT CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION, HYDERABAD, TELANGANA

Consumer Complaint No. [Insert Year if any, or leave blank]/2026

IN THE MATTER OF:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
Hyderabad, Telangana - [PIN Code]
...Complainant

VERSUS

[Name of E-Commerce Company]
[Address of E-Commerce Company / Corporate Office]
...Opposite Party

COMPLAINT UNDER SECTION 35 OF THE CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 2019 [KB:src_cpa_2019_35]

MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH:

1. That the Complainant is an ordinary resident of Hyderabad, Telangana, and falls within the definition of a "consumer" under Section 2(7) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 [KB:cpa_consumer_def], having purchased goods for consideration from the Opposite Party.

2. That on 2026-09-02, the Complainant ordered a phone worth Rs 32,999 on the e-commerce site of the Opposite Party, vide order invoice [mention order number if available].

3. That upon delivery, the said phone arrived with a cracked screen, rendering it defective and unusable.

4. That the Complainant promptly initiated a return through the platform, and the defective phone was picked up by the Opposite Party's logistics partner on 2026-09-05, as evidenced by the pickup receipt.

5. That despite the successful return and passage of the stipulated time frame, the Opposite Party has failed to process the refund of Rs 32,999. Customer care has delayed the matter indefinitely under the pretext that it takes 7-10 days, amounting to a deficiency in service and unfair trade practice under Section 2(11) and Section 2(47) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 [KB:cpa_consumer_def].

6. That the cause of action arose continuously starting from 2026-09-02 when the order was placed, on 2026-09-05 when the defective product was returned, and persists daily as the refund remains unpaid. The complaint is being filed well within the two-year limitation period under Section 69 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 [KB:cpa_limitation].

7. That this Commission has territorial and pecuniary jurisdiction to entertain this complaint under Section 34 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 [KB:src_cpa_2019_34], as the Opposite Party carries on business within Hyderabad and the value of the goods paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees.

PRAYER

In light of the facts mentioned above, the Complainant prays that this Hon'ble Commission may be pleased to:

a) Direct the Opposite Party to refund the principal amount of Rs 32,999 to the Complainant;

b) Award appropriate compensation for mental agony and harassment, along with litigation costs, as this Hon'ble Commission deems fit.

LIST OF DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
1. Copy of the order invoice dated 2026-09-02
2. Copy of the pickup receipt dated 2026-09-05
3. Any customer care chat transcripts or complaint reference numbers [if available]

VERIFICATION

I, [Your Name], the Complainant above named, do hereby verify that the contents of paragraphs 1 to 7 are true to my personal knowledge and belief, and no part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therein.

Verified at Hyderabad on this [date] day of [month], 2026.

[Your Signature]
[Your Name]

It requests the Commission to order the e-commerce company to refund your money along with compensation and costs.
